_source: post hoc RQ1 diagnosis (user 2026-10-06 'RQ1 반대 방향의 원인을 진단해보자'), after the A3 / A5 results. Outcomes = the A3 primary outcomes (A2 m = 4: site S_tau@0.01, @inf, pooled mix@1, mix@0.5) and the A1 RQ3 contrasts (main = (ii) - (iii), matched = N1 - Zm). Same runs as A3 (main bge-m3, 86 sites) and A3/A5 (30-site subset, 3 models). Slope model = the A3 interval of record (imported from A3/01_rq1.py), predictor = KB-O tag-distance rank (per 1 SD). Constants: our choices

scales._source: D1 scale dependence (our choice): ddp = d'(rel) - d'(abs) with d' = sqrt(2) Phi^-1(clip(AUROC)) (the A1-A3 gain metric); dA = AUROC(rel) - AUROC(abs); dOP = OOD acceptance(abs) - OOD acceptance(rel) at the calibrated threshold (95% of KB calibration queries; positive = fewer OOD accepted = gain); logratio = log(d'(rel) / d'(abs)) per draw when both d' > 0 (multiplicative gain; draws with d' <= 0 dropped and counted). For the A1 contrasts: differences of the same quantities between the (ii) slots (mean of N1, N2) or N1 and the (iii) slots (mean of Z1, Z2) or Zm

decomposition._source: D2 (our choice; A5 05_offdiag extended; review 2026-10-06 applied): binormal moment identity on test queries. Dmu = mean_ID - mean_OOD, sbar = sqrt((var_ID + var_OOD)/2): d_abs = Dmu_s/sbar_abs, d_rel = (Dmu_s - Dmu_c)/sbar_rel; d_rel - d_abs = T_var + T_push with the order-symmetric midpoint split T_push = -Dmu_c (1/sbar_abs + 1/sbar_rel)/2, T_var = (Dmu_s - Dmu_c/2)(1/sbar_rel - 1/sbar_abs); pi = sbar_abs/sbar_rel - 1 and d_abs reported as components (T_var is not simply proportional to d_abs: pi varies by cell). RQ3 contrast X vs Y (same fixed members; mean over slot pairs): B = Dmu_s - Dmu_c, h = (1/sbar_X + 1/sbar_Y)/2; variance part (B_X + B_Y)/2 (1/sbar_X - 1/sbar_Y), ID-side cost -(mu_c,X^ID - mu_c,Y^ID) h, OOD-side push (mu_c,X^OOD - mu_c,Y^OOD) h; every piece invariant to the cosine origin. Fidelity: Spearman and means of moment vs AUROC-based ddp, slope of resid = ddp - moment
decomposition.profile: D3 competing distance (diagnostic; uses OOD test queries): correlation over the banks other than KB and O of the KB and O test queries' mean similarities; slope of T_push with it as a covariate. Read as an embedding-space KB-O distance competing with the tag rank, not as a mechanism (review 2026-10-06)

predictions: recorded in JOURNAL 2026-10-06 before the run
model: as A3: y ~ x + (1|KB) + (1|O) + (0+x|KB) + (0+x|O), REML, Wald 95% (statsmodels MixedLM, variance components); x = rank standardised
